+title: 'MTP: ChatSession support with drafter-cache reuse across turns'
+---
+## What
+`ChatSession` (Libraries/MLXLMCommon/ChatSession.swift) supports only `SpeculativeDecodingConfig(draftModel: ModelContainer)`. It cannot use an MTP drafter. Add an MTP source, and keep the drafter cache in the session draft-cache slot, so that a multi-turn chat reuses the drafter prefix the same way it reuses the main prefix.
+
+- [ ] Add an MTP case to `SpeculativeDecodingConfig.DraftModelSource` (for example `.mtp(any MTPDrafterModel, blockSize:)`) with a public initializer such as `SpeculativeDecodingConfig(mtpDrafter:blockSize:memoryPolicy:)`. Use `drafter.isCompatible(with:)` to check the drafter against the target, and fall back to plain decode when it is not compatible.
+- [ ] In the generation path (~1660-1760), when the source is MTP, build `MTPSpeculativeTokenIterator` with the session main cache, the carried `lmState`, and the drafter state from the parent task. Keep the drafter `KVCacheStorage` in the `draftKVCache` slot.
+- [ ] Alignment for MTP: the drafter is aligned when `draftKVCache.processedTokenCount == kvCache.processedTokenCount - 1` and `lmState` carries the pending hidden row. Update the `draftCacheIsAligned` computation (~1387) and the `PromptCacheState` input so that `PromptCacheReusePolicy` sees MTP caches as aligned in the append-suffix case.
+- [ ] After a turn, store the final drafter state and `lmState` (with the pending hidden) in the conversation, as the session does for the main cache.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A two-turn `ChatSession` with Qwen3.8-27B-4bit + the MTP head at temperature 0 gives the same text as a session without speculation.
+- [ ] On turn 2, `cachedPromptTokenCount > 0`, and the drafter is not prefilled again over the cached prefix (assert on the drafter `processedTokenCount` before and after turn 2).
+- [ ] When the MTP drafter is not compatible with the target, the session falls back to plain decode, and an existing test shows that it does not throw.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Tests/MLXLMTests: a ChatSession test with a scripted random Qwen35 fixture + MTP head (reuse the shared scripted ChatSession builder from commit 478abaa1). It checks two turns for text equality with plain decode and for drafter-cache reuse.
+- [ ] IntegrationTesting/IntegrationTestingTests: a real-model test that skips when `mlx-community/Qwen3.8-27B-MTP-4bit` is not local, with the same two-turn equality.
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests && xcrun xctest .build/out/Products/Debug/MLXLMTests.xctest` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #mtp #qwen38 #chat-session
\ No newline at end of file
